fact: Bankable reports that Switch Mosolo is the national payment switch developed under the Central Bank of Congo's oversight, with FINCA the first microfinance institution to join a pilot connecting through the Mosolo card.
An agreement signed on 15 April 2026 connects microfinance institutions and savings cooperatives to the national card switch (switch monetique national) of the Banque centrale du Congo.

The Banque Centrale du Congo's map of the national payment system lists the payment service providers it has approved, among them five other financial companies including e-money issuers and 81 money-transfer firms, as at end-2023.

Le Point CD reports the Banque centrale du Congo joined PAPSS about a month before 21 October 2026; DRC banks and fintechs were only then invited to apply for membership and no transaction can be processed until they are connected.
